<thought>To design a ≤3‑step synthesis, I will disconnect the target at the sulfonamide bond. This gives two commercially available precursors: (1) p‑toluenesulfonyl chloride (TsCl) and (2) N‑acryloyl‑4‑aminophenyl (the phenyl bearing the trans‑CH=CH‑C(=O)NH‑ group and a free aniline). The latter can be obtained directly by acylating p‑phenylenediamine with acryloyl chloride, which is a single step from two cheap reagents. Thus the overall route is:  

Step 1: p‑Phenylenediamine + acryloyl chloride → N‑acryloyl‑4‑aminophenyl (selective mono‑acylation).  
Step 2: N‑acryloyl‑4‑aminophenyl + p‑toluenesulfonyl chloride → target sulfonamide.
